_1: Reaching headscale. false uses its unix socket and ignores the three keys below it. true uses gRPC at hs_address, which needs hs_api_key, plus hs_insecure_grpc only if the certificate there is self-signed.
_2: The hostname ouroboros itself is served on. Defaults to hs_login_url, so usually omit it.
_3: Your identity provider. Only the issuer URL is needed; endpoints come from discovery.
_4: Members of oidc_admin_value get /ouroboros/admin. Omit it and nobody is an admin. oidc_admin_claim can be any claim holding a list of strings - in authentik, groups (profile scope), or entitlements / roles (entitlements scope, which you must add to oidc_scopes).
_5: Usernames to headscale users. Matched against oidc_user_claim on a first login only.
